title: Curated chat bubbles from raw dictation

message.text: Design, kept simple. The raw words go into the box and are sent as they are now, and every send is already stored with the raw words in its `raw` field. The assistant never edits that line. It appends a new line that points at the bubble it revises: {"prompt_rev":{"of":"<prompt id>","text":"<tidied markdown>","by":"assistant"}}. What the assistant edits is only the `text` shown in the bubble: markdown, filler removed, capitalization and typos fixed, known terms corrected (a small term list, e.g. Cervex to Servex). The chat draws a bubble as the latest revision, with the raw words behind a collapsed "raw" line. A send that arrives soon after your last bubble, within about 10 seconds, revises that bubble's text instead of making a new one. Raw is stored in the card's log where it already is, and nothing is lost. Build first: the revision line plus the assistant step that writes it, with the term list. The chat drawing follows, and that half is in chat.js, which manager-new-card owns, so I'd pass it to them. Say go and I'll start the first piece.

Step one, merging your messages by time, is a chat-drawing change, so it belongs to manager-new-card, who owns the chat code. I've sent them the exact rule. Your consecutive messages under about 10 seconds apart, with no one else speaking between, draw as one bubble under one label, with each message as a markdown paragraph. The log lines stay separate, so nothing is rewritten. The curated rewrite comes after; I'll start its writing side when you say go.

Decision: a new tool for you, `amend_bubble({card, of, text})`, which appends one line to the card's log: {"type":"refined","of":"<prompt id>","text":"<tidied markdown>","by":"<you>"}. `refined` is already an event type in Servex/agents/Assistant.js (the cleaned reading), so this only adds the `of` pointer to the bubble it revises and a tool the per-card assistants can call. Nothing is deleted, because the raw words stay in the prompt line's `raw` field and the chat shows the latest refined text with raw folded beneath it. To honour never lose detail, never change meaning, the tool refuses a `text` much shorter than the raw (under about 60 percent of its length), and your brief says cleanup only: fix filler, caps, typos and known terms, and keep every idea, name and number. It is a change in Servex/, so it needs a Servex restart, and I'm passing it to the systems architect to build.

Folded in. A bubble is its raw pieces, meaning every prompt line merged into it by time, and the curated text sits on top. So the amend line carries a list: `of: [<prompt id>, …]`, not one id. The chat shows the latest refined line whose list covers the bubble, and a collapsed "raw" section shows the pieces in time order, each exactly as saved. A new raw piece landing within the merge window joins the bubble, and the assistant amends again with the longer list. No piece is edited or removed, and the length guard compares the curated text against all the pieces together.

Folded in. The curated text is a list of sections, each a heading or a paragraph, and each names the raw pieces it came from: `sections: [{text, from:[<prompt id>, …]}]`. `refined` already has a `cites` field, so this reuses that idea per section. The chat draws each section as markdown, and clicking it expands in place, with no popup, to show the raw words of the pieces it cites, exactly as saved. A section that cites nothing cannot expand. The length guard runs per section, so a section can't shrink its cited raw text below about 60 percent. Everything else is as designed.

Started: a minion is building the `amend_bubble` tool in Servex/agents/Layers.js. It has the raw-pieces list, sections that each cite their raw pieces, and a check that refuses a section shorter than about 60% of what it cites. The tool is added to the card assistants' tools, and each assistant's brief tells it to clean up only and never drop an idea, name or number. It won't be live until the architect's next Servex restart. The chat drawing with in-place expand is with manager-new-card.

Both are in. The rule that raw words always go along with any hand-off is now going into the card assistants' brief, so they paste your raw words verbatim under an "Owner's raw words" line when they pass work to a manager, a minion or another card. I've also told the systems architect to put it into the manager briefs and the create_card instructions. Clicking a bubble to expand it in place with its raw transcription is chat drawing, so it goes to manager-new-card along with the per-section expand.

Noted and queued behind the current minions. On a handoff, whoever picks the work up gets the path to the card's directory so they can read the whole chat log, raw included, not only summaries. I'm adding a line to the card assistants' brief now. Stamping the path automatically into task creation and the manager briefs is with the systems architect.

Landed in the code, waiting on a Servex restart to go live: the fast assistant gets an `amend_bubble` tool (sections that each cite their raw pieces, refused if a section is under about 60% of what it cites, own-card only), with 20 checks passing. The handoff rule is your corrected one: give the card's directory path, not pasted raw words. That is in the assistants' brief and the `ask_manager` description. I could not confirm the `create_card` wording changed. The chat drawing (merged bubble, click to expand to raw, per-section expand) is with manager-new-card. Dictate's handover for a fresh agent is at /framework/ux/Dictate/doc/handover/ and was not tested.

Started: a minion is adding this shape to the assistant's `amend_bubble` guidance. Each section is one title naming a core concept (chat bubble, transcription), with a checklist under it of what you said about it. Ideas said in several places merge under one title, and each section still cites its raw pieces. It includes a short worked example, and it goes live after the next Servex restart with the tool.

Done in the code: the `amend_bubble` guidance now says each section is a `## Title` naming one concept with a `- [ ]` checklist of what you said about it, `- [x]` for decided or done items, and a worked example with chat bubble and transcription. The tool description was tightened to match. The minion's report was cut off, so I did not see its test run. It goes live after the next Servex restart.

My opinion: keep the summaries as chat bubbles by default, and only promote one to a sub-card when a section names a thing that will be worked on, because 13 sub-cards on this page already shows that one card per summary would bury the real work. The bubble's sections already carry the concept titles and their raw pieces, so a section can later be turned into a sub-card with one click, from the same data, and nothing needs to change now.

It fits by changing where the sections point: each section of a curated bubble names a topic, and the raw pieces it cites are appended to that topic's sub-card log too, so the sub-card holds the topic's full raw words and the bubble stays the recent view. The `amend_bubble` guidance would grow one step, file each section's pieces to the matching sub-card, or make one if none exists, and the log stays append-only with the raw lines untouched. Filing to sub-cards is what the assistant's existing `file_to_group` idea already does for groups, so it reuses that path, and I would build it after the bubbles work.

Proposal, three groups. **Dictation box (6):** mic-start-stop-sounds, live-reload-cancels-transcription, transcribe-into-the-text-area, composer-layout-auto-height-live-paragra, text-area-stuck-open-at-fixed-height, merge-dictation-chunks-into-one-message. **Chat layout (3):** chat-as-right-hand-column, top-gap-and-sub-card-chat-column, one-layout-for-all-cards-resizable-colum. **Chat messages (4):** chat-log-scroll-duplicates-left-right, chat-replies-headings-prompts-paragraphs, render-markdown-in-chat-messages, curated-chat-bubbles-from-raw-dictation. I have not applied it. A sub-card's id is its folder path, so moving folders would change ids that chat lines, files and other cards point at, which is not simple and could lose links. The safe way to apply it is for the card page to show these three headings over the existing sub-cards, and that is a card.js change, so I'd pass it to manager-new-card.

Cards do not have tabs today: a card page draws its sub-cards as one table of contents, and only the task pages inside a card have their own tabs, so a tabbed card is new work in `card.js`. It fits the grouping well: one tab per group (Dictation box, Chat layout, Chat messages), each tab showing that group's sub-cards as the table of contents. Doing it from a `group` field on each sub-card keeps the ids and folders as they are, so it loses nothing, and it belongs to manager-new-card, who owns the card page.

Tab proposal now: **Overview** (the top-level summary: what this card is, its state, its refined summary) and **Tasks** (the 13 sub-cards, each a unit of work, with the three groups as headings inside it if you still want them). For names, I suggest a **card** is a topic you talk about (this one is Dictate), a **request** is one thing you asked for inside it, and a **task** is what an agent does to answer a request, so today's 13 sub-cards are requests, and each shows its tasks beneath it. The card log already uses `type: request`, so this matches the vocabulary the system has.

Handed off, not built by me yet. The card page code (card.js) is owned by manager-new-card, and my own context is nearly full, so I sent the systems architect the full spec: Overview and Tasks tabs, the three groups by a `group` field so no folders or ids move, and the card / request / task names. They will assign it to manager-new-card. Nothing on the page has changed yet.

I loaded the card at 1920 and nothing is broken: the page, tabs, chat column and composer all draw, with no missing or doubled text. The likeliest shock is the new Overview tab. After a full day of landed work it shows all 13 requests as unticked "To do" with "0 Delivered", and it is a flat list rather than a summary or the three groups. That is the tabbed-card code manager-new-card just built, so I've sent it to them through the architect to mark landed requests as delivered and make Overview a real summary. If it's something else, tell me what you see.

Checked the AI 2 main page, the Dictate card and a sub-card at 1920 and 3440: no console errors and no failed requests, and the chat column, tabs, dictation box and mic all draw. The Overview now shows 11 of 13 delivered in three groups. The one thing wrong I can see is that two finished requests still show unticked: "Text area stuck open at fixed height" (checked, it shrinks back after Send) and "Chat replies: headings, prompts, paragraphs" (landed). If it's something else, say where you are looking.
